description: Implementation of TransactionService handling payment transaction operations such as creation, listing, and retrieval of capturable and refundable transactions within a payment processing system.

classes.name: TransactionServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation for managing payment transactions, providing methods for creating transactions and querying specific transaction types related to payment authorization, capture, and refund.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transaction record, serializing transaction details into JSON format and saving it.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of transactions associated with a given order and populates their detailed information from JSON stored in the 'details' field.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Finds and returns the first authorization transaction that is eligible to be captured for a given order.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent refundable transaction (authorization, capture, or refund) for an order.
